`eval('echo SEEK_SET;')` was a runtime fatal while php printed 0. So were `FILE_APPEND`, the whole
`E_*` family, and 95 `STREAM_*` names — 149 in all, measured one program at a time, because a php
fatal is not catchable and putting them in one program only ever measures the first.
